svg.title: A puller's turn from the parking, each step (turn::step)

g.text: A puller's turn from the parking, each step (turn::step)
step(turn, model, rules, parking, input, dt)
step(run, model, rules, input with pull_on)
the pull's output; its result once the sled stops
result in: the sled held, stage kReleasing
(at the line: kParked, and nothing moves after)
pull_on off (any gear); a stalled engine starts
again once the clutch is pressed; parked: idle in neutral
unhooked, the chain pulls neither end;
driving back, it goes to the start line (sled::drive_back)
the rear tires stop against its fenders
hooks_on (standing, the hitch ahead of the hook within
the chain's length, near the sled's line): hooked, kTakingUpSlack
the chain within 0.1 m of tight (or tension >= 1 kN):
the slack is taken up, kWaitingForTheFlag
the chain 0.3 m slack: back to kTakingUpSlack
the chain eased back to its length; standing, the chain tight
(0.1 m short to 1 mm over), the drive out
(clutch pressed off its bite, or neutral), for 2 s without a break: the green flag, the sled on the chain,
standing, the chain 0.3 m slack: unhooked,
standing within 2 m of the parking: kParked
